resources.string: VocaGuard detects when a phone call is active so it can start real-time scam pattern analysis. This service observes phone call UI windows and does not read other app content.
Shows VocaGuard protection status on your home screen.
VocaGuard listens for scam patterns during live calls and alerts you immediately — before you hand over any personal information.
To screen calls and transcribe speech, VocaGuard needs the Phone, Microphone, and Accessibility permissions. Your audio is never sent off-device.
Adjust detection sensitivity, whitelist trusted numbers, and review call transcripts whenever you like. VocaGuard works quietly in the background.

VocaGuard records call audio to detect scam patterns in real time. All audio is processed locally on your device and is never uploaded to any server. By tapping \"Get Started\" you consent to call audio recording for scam detection purposes.
